rows.summary: A little success can make you feel ten feet tall, which is exactly when saying yes to everything starts looking reasonable.
rows.body: A little success can make you feel ten feet tall, which is exactly when saying yes to everything starts looking reasonable. When the Sun conjoins Jupiter, confidence and possibility expand together, making a bigger opportunity, audience, goal, or leap of faith feel unusually easy to believe in. This is generous astrology, and there may be very good reasons to take the bigger swing. Just remember that enthusiasm can make the cost of expansion look smaller than it is. Choose the opportunity that makes your life bigger without making your obligations bigger than the life carrying them.

rows.summary: Once you know what you want, the distance between deciding and acting can become almost nonexistent.
rows.body: Once you know what you want, the distance between deciding and acting can become almost nonexistent. When the Sun conjoins Mars, identity and drive fuse, concentrating confidence, anger, courage, and initiative into a powerful need to do something rather than keep waiting. That force can help you make a move you have been avoiding, but it can also make resistance feel like a personal challenge that has to be defeated. Use the heat on the decision that actually requires courage, not on proving that nobody gets to slow you down.

rows.summary: Your thoughts can feel unusually personal when saying what you mean also feels like saying who you are.
rows.body: Your thoughts can feel unusually personal when saying what you mean also feels like saying who you are. When the Sun conjoins Mercury, identity and communication fuse, making it easier to put your ideas forward with confidence and much harder to separate disagreement from criticism of you personally. This can be excellent astrology for writing, pitching, deciding, or having the conversation you have been rehearsing. Just remember that changing your mind does not weaken your position. A better idea is allowed to replace the one you were certain about five minutes ago.

rows.summary: What you want and what you need can become so closely tied together that one decision suddenly feels capable of resetting the whole emotional landscape.
rows.body: What you want and what you need can become so closely tied together that one decision suddenly feels capable of resetting the whole emotional landscape. When the Sun conjoins the Moon, intention and feeling fuse, concentrating your attention around whatever seems most personally important right now. That clarity can help you choose a direction, but it can also make the present mood feel like the only truth available. Start from what feels essential. You do not need to turn one strong feeling into a permanent verdict on everything that came before it.

rows.summary: A beautiful possibility can feel more like destiny when it reflects the person you desperately want to become.
rows.body: A beautiful possibility can feel more like destiny when it reflects the person you desperately want to become. When the Sun conjoins Neptune, identity and imagination fuse, making inspiration, intuition, creativity, and idealism unusually powerful while the line between vision and projection gets thinner. The dream may be worth following, but wanting something to mean everything can make ordinary warning signs surprisingly easy to excuse. Let yourself be inspired without requiring the fantasy to prove anything about who you are. What matters will survive a closer look.

rows.summary: A decision can become much more intense once getting your way starts feeling tied to proving that nobody else gets to control you.
rows.body: A decision can become much more intense once getting your way starts feeling tied to proving that nobody else gets to control you. When the Sun conjoins Pluto, identity and power fuse, concentrating ambition, desire, fear, and control around whatever feels most consequential. This can give you the nerve to confront something you have avoided for too long, but it can also turn a solvable disagreement into a referendum on who has the upper hand. Notice when the outcome has stopped being the point. Power is more useful when it changes the situation, not just who wins the standoff.

rows.summary: Responsibility can feel especially personal when the thing you have to carry starts looking like evidence of what you are capable of.
rows.body: Responsibility can feel especially personal when the thing you have to carry starts looking like evidence of what you are capable of. When the Sun conjoins Saturn, identity and duty fuse, making deadlines, commitments, criticism, or added authority feel heavier because your confidence is wrapped up in meeting the standard. This is strong astrology for taking yourself seriously and doing work that requires discipline. It is not a reason to treat exhaustion like proof of character. Carry what genuinely belongs to you without turning every limit into a test you have to pass.

rows.summary: The urge to do something completely differently gets harder to ignore when the old version of your life no longer feels like you.
rows.body: The urge to do something completely differently gets harder to ignore when the old version of your life no longer feels like you. When the Sun conjoins Uranus, identity and disruption fuse, making experimentation, independence, and sudden changes of direction feel unusually personal and urgent. A break from routine may reveal something you have outgrown, but shock value is not the same thing as freedom. Change the part that gives you more room to be yourself. You do not have to destroy everything familiar just to prove the change is yours.

rows.summary: Someone else’s urgency can easily turn a routine disagreement into a contest over who holds the final say.
rows.body: Someone else’s urgency can easily turn a routine disagreement into a contest over who holds the final say. When the Sun opposes Mars, your core direction comes up against another person's push to compete, confront, or move faster, which makes both sides dig in harder than the situation requires. If a conversation shifts from solving a problem to defending authority, steer it back to the actual decision on the table. You do not have to match someone else's escalation to maintain your own leverage. Address the logistical issue in front of you and leave them to manage their own adrenaline.

rows.summary: Mixed signals can make it hard to tell if something is genuinely promising or if you are filling in the blanks with what you hope is true.
rows.body: Mixed signals can make it hard to tell if something is genuinely promising or if you are filling in the blanks with what you hope is true. When the Sun opposes Neptune, confidence and clarity come up against uncertainty and projection, so a person, plan, or opportunity can look more convincing from a distance than it does once you ask for specifics. If the story keeps changing, the answer stays vague, or you are doing most of the explaining for why it could work, slow down before committing more time, money, or trust. You do not have to abandon the possibility. Wait until you have enough information to know what you are actually saying yes to.
